title: Gluing local harmonic representatives on the unit ball
statement: Let n >= 1, B the open unit ball of R^n, and w : R^n -> R. Suppose that for every eps with 0 < eps < 1/2 there is v : R^n -> R that is harmonic near every point of ball(0, 1 - eps) with v = w almost everywhere on ball(0, 1 - 2 eps). Then there is u : R^n -> R that is harmonic near every point of B (InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u B) with u = w almost everywhere on B.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ w : Rn n → ℝ, (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → ∃ v : Rn n → ℝ, InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd v (ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - ε)) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - 2 * ε))), v x = w x) → ∃ u : Rn n → ℝ, InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)), u x = w x
